description: Use when you need to extract text from a pdf, pdf to text or document parsing for an LLM. Do not use for scanned PDFs (no OCR), password-protected files or files over 15 MB. Returns JSON with PDF text extraction: the text of each page (first 20 pages) plus title, author and producer metadata for 0.0025 USDC per page, up to 0.05 USDC per call (clients without upto pay the cap). Result in the same call (about 10000 ms); a status tool polls for free if it takes longer. Category: Data. Price: US$0.05 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the PDF file, e.g. https://example.com/report.pdf (up to 15 MB)

name: blackwood_pdf_extract
title: PDF to text
